decisions.reason: As a newly launched feature tightly linked to the firm's secure identity ecosystem, management is likely to keep it while results are still uncertain and organisational slack supports learning.
Because an identity-bound wallet fits the firm's super-app and payment ambitions, management would likely tolerate early uncertainty unless performance clearly falls below aspiration levels.
The NFC login authenticator is more niche and likely faces more uncertain demand, but as a recent security-related launch it would probably be retained for another year before redeploying resources.
A secure payment and wallet framework is close to the firm's core capabilities and strategic direction, so management would be inclined to continue it absent strong evidence of underperformance.
This product appears central to the firm's stated move toward secure multi-service platforms, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.
The application shielding library builds directly on the firm's long-standing security expertise and likely meets strategic aspiration even if commercial outcomes are still emerging.
